correctness.rationale: Every color support uses at least two points; with 2r+1 total, at most one color has a triple support. Hence the entire Hom complex is triangles meeting only at vertices, with every edge in one triangle. Canonical center-coning and simultaneous removal of the three free outer edges is group equivariant. The connected incidence graph gives the exact integral boundary kernel, all characters and quotients; free source-color action and orbit transitivity give the stated rational module. Exact code verifies r=2,3,4 with no extrapolation used as proof.
